name: 萨珂
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4225
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 209）｜贫（营里车底下长大的）｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇照这一纪顶上那一身，英雄往上不看家境；白骸不造炉，写成刻着点名字的骨鳞长衣和骨胫甲；页上没写兵器，起了一根骨包脚的探沼长杖（★）
who: Sako, called the Marker in the Marsh, a bone-kin demon of the White Bone camps, Third Camp number four hundred and eight, the legendary pathfinder who led three whole camps out of a flooded poison marsh; her name was fixed at a hundred and fifty-six and she has looked twenty-five or twenty-six ever since: about 174 cm, long-boned and rangy. Ash-pale grey-white skin, two pale natural bone ridges showing along both sides of her neck. Grey hair cut straight at the jaw. Dark moss-green eyes. A ring of black marsh-mud stain around each ankle that never washes off. No horns and no jewellery. A quiet, patient, waiting air; she looks at people as if waiting for them to answer a roll call.
build: 174 cm, long-boned and slender: lean, strong shoulders, a B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips, long legs.
palette: bone white and ash grey, marsh-mud black, dark moss green, faded felt grey
casual: Her camp travelling dress: a long heavy grey felt cloak whose hem is sewn with a ring of small bone buttons, over a dark grey wool tunic to mid-thigh belted with a broad hide belt, close dark trousers and mud-caked knee boots; at her right hip a slim carved bone case holding a short, rotten old marsh stake. She stands half turned as if looking back down a line of people, one hand cupped near her ear waiting for the last answer, a calm, patient look.
private: On dry ground at a halt: the cloak off, a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, the dark trousers rolled to the shin, barefoot, the black mud rings around her ankles showing. She holds one boot upside down in one hand, shaking out bits of bone and clods of mud, a small private smile.
battle: Leading the charge up the lamplit slope, in the war harness of the White Bone camps' greatest pathfinder: a long fitted coat of pale bone scales laced over dark felt, every scale carved with tiny roll-call numbers glowing a cold pale green, a high bone collar over the natural ridges of her neck, sculpted bone greaves to the knee whose edges shine hard bone-white, the grey felt cloak cut short and pinned back at the shoulders with bone clasps carved with camp numbers; the slim bone case with the old marsh stake at her hip. She grips a tall sounding staff of pale ash wood shod with bone and iron, its foot glowing white as if hardening the air beneath it, the left hand raised open as if calling the last name, a stern, unwavering look.
formal: At a camp roll call: a long pale grey felt gown closing down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, a mantle of bleached bone beads over the shoulders, each bead carved with a camp number, a broad hide belt with the bone case and its old stake at the hip, clean soft boots. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark green eyes looking past the viewer back down a long line of people, the lips parted on a name. Cold grey dawn light over flood water from one side, a pale bone-white glow rising from a hardened path from the other. Foreground blur: rotten marsh stakes, drifting marsh mist, the rim of a cart wheel.

name: 拉扎尔·浮网
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4108
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 212）｜贫（盐海北岸网户）｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇照顶上那一身；1146年已有成批的附魔甲，还没有炉甲，写成量身打的海蓝符文鳞甲配绞盘形的大肩甲，铁链穿掌是页上写的招牌
who: Lazar Floatnet, called the Chain That Never Leaves the Hand, a human net-fisher of the north shore of the Salt Sea and the legendary warden of the Red Shoal Chain; he reached hero rank in a shipwreck and aged slowly, and when his name was fixed at sixty-six he looked about fifty, and has looked so ever since: tall, 188 cm, thick-backed and narrow-waisted, two heavy arms hanging like coils of soaked cable. Grey hair cropped close to the skull, a short beard streaked with white, a nose reddened by the salt wind, deep-set sea-green eyes, a face carved with salt-wind lines. Through the centre of his right palm (on the viewer's left when he faces us) a clean round hole rimmed by a ring of grown bone, where a chain once passed; light shows through it even through a bandage. No jewellery. A warm, rough, steady air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a rugged, weathered human face of about fifty, deep-set sea-green eyes with crow's feet, heavy grey brows, deep salt-wind lines across the forehead and cheeks, a broad nose reddened at the bridge, a short grey beard streaked with white, a wide mouth whose grin shows a front tooth with one corner chipped off; skin fair but weathered, ruddy at the nose and cheekbones.
build: 188 cm, tall, thick-backed and narrow-waisted, long heavy arms and big hands.
palette: salt white and rust red, net-hemp brown, deep sea blue, chain-iron grey, molten red-gold
casual: His shore work clothes: a heavy oiled deep-blue wool fisherman's jacket with horn toggles over a coarse hemp shirt, the sleeves rolled to the forearm, a wide leather belt with a small pouch of spare chain pins wrapped in a square of old knotted net, salt-stained canvas trousers and tall sea boots; a strip of clean linen loosely wound around the right hand, a point of light still showing through the palm. He holds out a dry folded coat in the left hand as if offering it, a crooked, warm grin.
private: Mending nets on a rest day: a faded hemp shirt open at the collar, braces over it, rolled canvas trousers, barefoot. He holds a wooden net needle and a loop of hemp twine, the right palm bare with light glinting through the hole, a contented look.
battle: Hauling the reef shut, in the legendary warden's harness of the Red Shoal Chain: a heavy fitted sea-blue coat of overlapping salt-white enchanted scales over fine mail, every rune line glowing ember red-gold, massive rune-etched steel pauldrons shaped like capstan drums, layered rune bracers, a broad belt of chain links with the small net-wrapped pouch of chain pins. A great iron chain is wound three times around his right forearm and passed straight through the hole in his right palm, its links glowing molten red-gold and trailing off to one side, white salt crystals growing along it. Both hands grip the chain, the body leaning back hard against the pull, a fierce, gritted grin.
formal: At the lamp-lighting of the Red Shoal Chain: a long deep-blue wool coat closing down the front with brass buttons, a clean linen shirt, a salt-white sash, polished sea boots, the beard trimmed, the right hand bare. He holds a single huge iron chain link, polished bright, across both palms before his chest, a grave look.
art: A low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the sea-green eyes looking at the viewer with a crooked grin, the right palm raised beside his face with a thin beam of light shining through the hole in it. Cold sea-spray light from one side, the molten red-gold glow of a chain from the other. Foreground blur: spray, glowing iron links, salt crystals.

name: 琳琪
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4186
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 207，约1280年起；1240年凝名时还在英雄）｜中（风啸牧户）｜照常｜5档｜传奇照顶上那一身；风啸牧带的守弓人，写成量身打的风鳞猎装、折翼形的护臂和绕风的白羽箭，刻名长弓是页上的招牌
who: Linqi, called the Bow on the Cliff Top, a wolf-eared beastkin of the Windhowl herding bands, the legendary archer of Featherfall Cliff; her name was fixed at twenty-five and she has looked twenty-five ever since: about 171 cm, long-legged, with a thin but strong back. A pair of deep-grey wolf ears with a ring of silver-white along their rims, and a matching deep-grey wolf tail. Chestnut hair tied short at the nape. Very pale light-brown eyes. A few faint freckles on the cheeks, a stray grass seed often caught in her lashes. Fair skin. A tall hardwood longbow whose back bears one single carved name and nothing else. No jewellery. A warm, open, sociable air, with a slow, careful way of asking questions.
build: 171 cm, long-legged and lean: a thin, strong back, a B-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: deep grey and silver-white, chestnut, sky grey, faded rust and blue, white feather
casual: Her herding-band clothes: a short sleeveless jerkin of felted yak wool over a long-sleeved undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the shoulder, a broad woven sash in faded rust and blue, close leather riding trousers and soft knee boots; the tall hardwood longbow slung across her back. She holds a newborn lamb wrapped in a scrap of felt in both arms, the wolf ears pricked, a bright, friendly smile.
private: At ease among the herders: a loose long-sleeved wool tunic dyed soft heather blue, belted with a cord, wool trousers and felt boots. She holds a small whittling knife and a half-finished arrow shaft up to her eye, checking that it is straight, the nose wrinkled, a fussy look.
battle: Holding the cliff slope, in the legendary warden-archer's gear of the Windhowl bands: a fitted sky-grey hunting coat of layered enchanted wind-scale plates over soft leather, the plate edges etched with flowing wind runes glowing pale silver-green, a sculpted bracer on the left forearm shaped like a folded wing, a quiver of white-fletched arrows whose shafts shimmer with bound wind, long silver-edged streamers at her back lifting in a wind that wraps around her. She draws the tall hardwood longbow to full, the single name carved along its back glowing faintly, the arrow wrapped in a spiralling white wind, one wolf ear turned forward and one back, the tail held flat to one side, a cool, intent look.
formal: At a herd-gathering feast: a long sky-grey wool coat-dress closing down the front with carved bone toggles, fitted sleeves, the hem and cuffs embroidered with a band of white feathers, a wide rust-red sash, a short cape of silver-grey wolf fur over the shoulders, polished boots. She holds the tall longbow upright and unstrung beside her, a calm, grave look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale eyes looking down and past the viewer, the wolf ears turned toward a sound, the fingertips of one hand tracing the name carved on the back of the bow. Thin high-cliff dawn light from one side, a cold silver wind-glow from the other. Foreground blur: drifting white feathers, wind-blown grass, a small wildflower torn from its stem.

name: 阿妲·托尔德朵蒂
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4147
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 216，约1350年起）｜中（长船人家）｜照常｜5档｜长船破阵船首的传奇，照顶上那一身；北边长船不在墙后的工场里，甲照船上的路子不封胳膊，两条胳膊露着是页上写的；冒白气的舵是她的兵器
who: Ada Toldardottir, called the Black-Water Helm, a human of the northern longship clans, the legendary helmswoman who rammed eleven ships in one winter night; her name was fixed at twenty-eight and she has looked twenty-eight ever since: tall, 179 cm, broad-shouldered, with thick strong arms and a firm waist. Red-brown hair in three long braids. Blue-grey eyes. Thick brows. A faint pale scar running straight across the bridge of her nose from a falling mast. A small carved bone pendant in each earlobe. Fair skin flushed by the sea wind. A loud, bright, big-sister air; she tilts her head before she laughs so her earrings will not swing into anyone.
build: 179 cm, tall and powerfully built: broad shoulders, thick strong arms, a C-cup, a firm waist and full hips.
palette: red-brown and bone ivory, deep sea blue, frost white, ember orange, dark fur brown
casual: Her longship deck clothes: a sleeveless thick wool tunic of dark sea blue with a woven red-and-white border, a broad leather belt, a heavy fur-lined cloak knotted around her waist by its sleeves, close wool trousers and fur-topped sea boots; both strong arms bare. A small bag of dried berries hangs from one hand by its drawstring, the head tilted, a bright, broad smile.
private: By the winter-camp fire: a long-sleeved undyed wool tunic with a red-stitched collar, wool trousers, soft fur boots, the three braids loose over one shoulder. She holds a wooden cup of something hot in both hands, laughing with the head tilted.
battle: Ramming through the winter night, in the legendary war gear of the longship clans: a sleeveless fitted coat of dark sea-blue enchanted scale over quilted wool, its rune lines glowing furnace orange, broad rune-etched steel pauldrons swept back like wings of frost and rimmed with white rime, no sleeves so the bare strong arms show, the fur cloak knotted around her waist; plumes of white steam rise from her shoulders. She grips a long ship's steering oar upright in both hands, its broad iron-shod blade beside her and the tiller end studded with three copper nails, the whole shaft steaming white and glowing red-hot along its grain, the head tilted, a bold grin.
formal: At the winter-camp feast: a long deep-red wool overdress with tablet-woven bands at the hem and neckline, over a pale linen underdress with long fitted sleeves, a pair of oval bronze brooches at the shoulders strung with a swag of amber beads, a short cape of white fur, the three braids bound with bronze rings. She stands tall with one hand on her hip, a proud, warm smile.
art: A low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-grey eyes looking at the viewer with a fierce grin, white steam rising from the steering oar on her shoulder. Cold blue night light off black sea water from one side, the orange glow of the hot oar shaft from the other. Foreground blur: shards of floating ice, frozen spray, a splintered mast.

name: 阿鲁赫
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4264
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 218）｜中（峡湾船家）｜不靠兵器（唱帆人）｜5档｜撼世传奇照顶上那一身；深潮不造炉，写成海草筋织的长衣配鳍形鳞甲、深潮字的冷绿光；他是唱帆领船的，页上没有兵器，第三格写 battle_pose 空手唱，随身的铜杯拿在手里
who: Aluh, called the Sail Against the Wind, a deep-tide demon of the fjord sea-clans on the western continent's north shore, the legendary sail-singer and raider who led twelve ships out of a fjord against a gale; his name was fixed at a hundred and ninety-five and he has looked twenty-seven or twenty-eight ever since: very tall, 191 cm, broad-chested and lean-waisted. Black hair slicked back. Dark gold eyes, long at the outer corners. The corners of his mouth turn down slightly by nature. A layer of fine blue-black fins along the backs of his shoulders, and long thin gill slits on both sides of his neck. Pale skin with a faint cool blue-grey cast. A clear-boned, cold, stern face that never shows that he gets seasick.
build: 191 cm, very tall, broad-chested and lean-waisted, long arms.
palette: pale undyed wool and storm grey, blue-black, dark gold, cold sea green, old copper
casual: His seagoing clothes: a long, thick pale undyed wool robe closing down the front with horn toggles, fitted sleeves whose cuffs are washed whiter than the rest, a broad dark sealskin belt, close dark trousers and soft sealskin boots. He holds a small old copper cup in one hand, the lips pressed tight, a cold, composed look.
private: In the boathouse: a loose dark blue linen shirt open at the throat with the sleeves rolled up, dark trousers, barefoot. He is wiping out the old copper cup with a cloth, an unhurried, quiet look.
battle: Singing the sails against the wind, in the war dress of the greatest sail-singer of the fjord clans: a long pale storm-grey coat woven with seaweed sinew, its edges stitched with deep-tide script glowing cold sea green, over a fitted harness of overlapping blue-black scale plates shaped like his own fins, a tall stiff collar open at the sides to leave the gills free, sculpted scale pauldrons trailing long strips of torn sail-cloth that billow backward against the wind; broad sea-green sigils of wind spiral around his raised arm. He carries no weapon: the right arm is flung forward with the hand open toward the wind, the left hand holds the small old copper cup, the lips parted in a long chant, a hard, cold look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced on wide-planted feet, the right arm flung forward with the hand open as if commanding the wind, the left hand holding a small old copper cup, the lips parted in a long chant, a hard, cold expression; he holds no weapon.
formal: Before a gathering of the fjord clans: a long deep sea-blue coat of heavy wool closing down the front with silver-grey fish-bone buttons, fitted sleeves, a mantle of dark seal fur, a broad belt with a fish-bone buckle, dark trousers and polished sealskin boots. He stands very straight with the hands clasped behind him, a cold, proud look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark gold eyes lifting to meet the viewer at the end of a sentence, the wind whipping his black hair, one hand holding the copper cup near his chin. Grey snow light from one side, a green-white glow off a towering wall of sea water from the other. Foreground blur: blowing snow, taut sail ropes, a sail bellied the wrong way.

name: 屈内贡德·断崖
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4537
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 217）｜中（矿匠人家）｜照常｜5档｜传奇照顶上那一身；矮人矿匠、后来修炮台台基，写成符文锻的胸甲裙甲、水轮片形的阶梯肩甲，槽里流着河蓝的光，祖轮锤是页上的招牌
who: Kunegund Sheercliff, called the Fall-Turner, a dwarf woman of the Sheer Cliff line, the legendary miner who turned a three-hundred-fathom waterfall back up its own cliff for half a day; her name was fixed at a hundred and fifty-six, a dwarf in her prime, and she has looked so ever since: short, 144 cm, broad and solid, every muscle of her arms clearly defined. Copper-brown hair braided into wide plaits lying flat against the scalp. Thick brows. Warm brown eyes. A round face with firm cheeks. A plain flat iron ring in the left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us), her grandmother's. A faint dusting of glittering crystal powder on the tip of her nose. No goggles and no other jewellery. A loud, lively, patient air; she listens before she strikes.
face: FACE, as in the references: a grown woman's face, round with firm cheeks, warm brown eyes, thick straight copper-brown brows, a small straight nose dusted with fine glittering crystal powder at the tip, a wide mouth that laughs loudly; fair skin with rosy cheeks.
build: 144 cm, short and powerfully built: thick shoulders and back, strong defined arms, a B-cup, a sturdy waist, broad hips and heavy thighs.
palette: copper brown and river blue, moss green wool, dark rune steel, crystal glitter, warm lantern orange
casual: Her water-wheel mine work clothes: a heavy leather work apron over a thick moss-green wool shirt with the sleeves rolled above the elbow, the hem rolled up and tucked so it cannot catch in a wheel axle, a broad belt hung with a few small chisels and a sounding rod, sturdy brown trousers and iron-capped boots. She holds the wide-faced heirloom hammer resting head-down against her boot, its haft wrapped in three bands of old iron, one ear cocked as if listening to an axle, a lively, ready grin.
private: Off shift in the wheel shed: a loose cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a brown wool waistcoat unbuttoned, the trousers rolled to the shin, soft felt slippers. She holds a broken old wooden wheel spoke in both hands, thumbing a tiny carved mark on it, a soft, fond look.
battle: Holding up the twelfth battery, in the legendary rock-warden's war harness of the Sheer Cliff dwarves: a heavy fitted cuirass and tassets of dark rune-forged steel whose deep-cut channels glow river blue like running water, broad stepped pauldrons shaped like segments of a mill wheel, thick rune bracers and greaves, a short leather apron below the cuirass with its hem rolled up and tied. She grips the wide-faced heirloom hammer in both hands at a low swing, its haft wrapped in three bands of old iron and a short wheel spoke carved on the back of its head, blue-white light and a curling arc of glowing water spiralling off the hammer face, a braced, determined look.
formal: At a Sheer Cliff clan gathering: a long rust-brown wool overdress to the ankles closing down the front with copper buttons, fitted sleeves, a broad copper-studded belt, a short cape of dark felt, the plaits freshly re-braided and bound with copper wire. She stands squarely with the heirloom hammer upright in front of her, both hands resting on the end of its haft, a proud, beaming look.
art: A low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the round face large, the brown eyes looking at the viewer with a loud, open laugh, the heirloom hammer on her shoulder. The silver-white mist of a waterfall hanging still in mid-air from one side, warm lantern light from the wheel shed from the other. Foreground blur: water droplets hanging motionless, broken wheel spokes, drifting crystal dust.

name: 刻玛·赤脊
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4420
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 224）｜中（赤脊氏冲阵队）｜照常｜5档｜炎角冲阵的传奇，照顶上那一身；炮的年月炎角是黑曜刃、赤铜，写成黑曜赤铜的胸甲、半熔的冲阵盾、角上一丈高的火；左臂袒着露三道疤（页上她卷袖给人看），黑曜阔刃页上没写，照补层起（★）
who: Kema Redspine, called the Thunder-Scorched, a fire-horn demon of the Red Spine clan, the legendary vanguard who walked through three thunder-cannon blasts to the foot of the wall; her name was fixed at about two hundred and ten and she has looked twenty-seven or twenty-eight ever since: tall, 186 cm, broad-shouldered and long-legged. Short black hair with a deep red sheen. Copper-gold eyes. Sharp brows, high cheekbones, small fangs. A pair of horns curving back from the temples, their roots split with glowing cracks like burst embers. A thin line of fine red scales running down her spine. Three horizontal brand scars across the left upper arm (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Warm fair skin with a faint red undertone. A sharp, proud, prickly air.
build: 186 cm, tall and powerful: broad shoulders, a C-cup, a firm waist, full hips and long, strong legs.
palette: black obsidian and red-bronze, ember orange, copper gold, dark crimson hide
casual: Her camp dress: a sleeveless short red-brown leather jerkin laced up the front and cut low at the back to show the line of red scales, close dark leather trousers, heavy war boots, a broad belt with her late sister's blunt old armour-awl hung in a loop; the scarred left arm bare. She stands with one foot propped on the rim of her round charging shield, an elbow on her knee, a sharp, fanged grin.
private: Off duty by her clan's fire: a loose dark red long-sleeved linen shirt, the left sleeve rolled high to the shoulder to bare the three scars, dark trousers, barefoot. She holds her sister's blunt old armour-awl, tracing the edge of one scar with its tip, a quiet, hard look.
battle: Charging the wall through three thunder blasts, in the legendary war harness of the Red Spine fire-horns: a fitted breastplate and tassets of black obsidian plates edged in glowing red-bronze, cut open at the back to bare the line of red scales down her spine, one massive sculpted obsidian pauldron on the right shoulder only (on the viewer's left), the scarred left arm bare from the shoulder, armoured greaves; orange-red fire roars a full arm's length up from both back-swept horns, the ember cracks at the horn roots blazing. She carries a heavy red-bronze and obsidian charging shield on the right arm, its face half melted and glowing, and a broad black obsidian war blade in the left hand, NOT a curved sword, a fierce, fanged grin.
formal: At a Red Spine war council: a long black wool war coat closing down the front with red-bronze clasps, fitted sleeves, the left sleeve cut away at the shoulder to show the three scars, a broad red-bronze belt, a mantle of dark red-dyed hide over the shoulders, polished boots. She stands with the arms folded and the chin up, a proud, challenging look.
art: A low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the copper-gold eyes daring the viewer, a fanged grin, the scarred left forearm raised toward the camera. Searing red thunder-light from one side, blazing orange horn-fire from above. Foreground blur: flying drops of molten metal, sparks, the out-of-focus glowing mouth of a cannon.

name: 纳尔萨
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4576
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 214）｜中（深潮船家）｜照常｜5档｜劫岛的雾领，照顶上那一身；深潮不造炉，写成海草绸长衣配鳍形鳞甲、珍珠白的深潮字；页上没写兵器，照补层深潮使鱼叉起了一柄细长鱼叉（★），右襟灯罩铜片照页上
who: Narsa, called the Fin in the Fog, a deep-tide demon who led a raiding fleet among the islands of the Tidesong archipelago, the legendary fog-lord who struck nine outer islands in one winter; his name was fixed at about two hundred and forty and he has looked twenty-five or twenty-six ever since: tall, 187 cm, level-shouldered and long-waisted, smooth and strongly built. Sea-teal skin. A pair of fan-shaped silver fins spreading behind his ears. Straight black hair to the collarbone. Grey-blue eyes so pale they look almost colourless. Two small dark natural marks under the eyes like drops of water that never dried. A long, handsome face, thin lips, and a gentle, courteous smile that grows gentler the harder the bargain.
build: 187 cm, tall, level-shouldered and long-waisted, with smooth, strong arms and legs.
palette: sea teal and silver, deep blue, fog white, old lamp copper, pale grey-blue
casual: His raiding-fleet dress: a long deep-blue over-robe open at the front over a fitted sea-grey sleeveless tunic, its right lapel sewn with several salvaged old lamp-shade copper plates, a sash of dark sea silk, close dark trousers, bare feet. He holds a folded, oil-stained hand-drawn chart of lighthouses, a soft, polite smile.
private: Resting aboard: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, dark trousers, barefoot, the damp hair tucked behind his fins. He holds a small glass lamp chimney up to the light, checking how cleanly it has burned, an absorbed, almost tender look.
battle: Hiding the fleet in fog, in the legendary raid-lord's gear of the deep tide: a long open deep-blue sea coat of seaweed-sinew silk over a close harness of overlapping silver-teal fin-shaped scale plates, the plate edges inscribed with deep-tide script glowing a cold pearl white, the right lapel still sewn with old salvaged lighthouse copper plates polished bright, scale bracers, bare feet; veils of white fog spill from his shoulders and the fins behind his ears flare wide and glow silver. He holds a slender long harpoon with a barbed silver head low in his right hand, the left hand open and sweeping as if steering the fog, a gentle, courteous smile.
formal: Receiving a ransom: a long fitted deep-blue coat closing down the front with polished old lighthouse brass buttons, fitted sleeves, the right lapel's copper plates polished bright, a soft high collar, a sash of pale sea silk, dark trousers and soft sealskin shoes. He stands with the hands loosely clasped in front, a gentle, patient, unnerving smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale grey-blue eyes looking at the viewer through drifting fog with a warm, courteous smile, the silver fins behind his ears catching the light. A distant lighthouse beam turning through the fog from one side, cold sea-green light from below. Foreground blur: thick white fog, the reflection in a lamp glass, wet rope.

name: 德赫恩·琥鳞
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4498
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 220；2996年到天灾 LVL 233）｜中（琥鳞氏族）｜照常｜5档｜龙雷炮手照炮的年月补层（小臂不穿袖露鳞，鳞缝透红），写成琥珀铜的龙鳞胸甲和大肩甲；他的兵器是一门龙雷炮，立绘拿不动，战斗格抱一颗刻符文的雷弹（★）
who: Dehrn Amberscale, called the Spent-Blood Breech, a dragonkin of the Amberscale clan of the Sky Spine, the legendary dragon-thunder gun-captain who fired eleven shots in one night to hold a mountain pass; his name was fixed at about a hundred and seventy, his strong dragon blood aging him slowly, and he has looked just past twenty ever since: huge, 205 cm, deep-chested and broad-backed. Shoulder-length black hair. Gold-brown eyes. Two short horns behind the brow line. Large amber scales running along both forearms past the elbows. Faint dark red lines like veins of light under his skin that glow bright after firing and leave his face pale when they cool. High brow ridges and a broad nose. A loud, gruff, scolding air, with careful hands.
build: 205 cm, huge and powerful: a deep chest, a broad thick back, heavy arms.
palette: amber and bronze, thunder red, soot black leather, snow white, pale gold-brown
casual: His gun-crew dress: a heavy dark leather gunner's apron over a sleeveless thick charcoal wool shirt, both forearms bare to the amber scales, a broad belt hung with a brass firing rod and a ring of rune keys, dark trousers and iron-capped boots, an ear-flap leather gunner's cap hanging at his back by its strap. He holds a dented tin water cup carefully in both big hands, a gruff scowl.
private: Off the gun line: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, a dark wool waistcoat, dark trousers and soft boots. He holds a small worn wooden board with his crew's names scratched on it, reading it, a tired, quiet look.
battle: Pressing his blood-thunder into the eleventh shot, in the legendary gun-captain's war harness of the Amberscale dragonkin: a heavy fitted breastplate of amber-bronze dragon-scale plates over dark leather, every scale glowing from within along its edges, massive layered scale pauldrons, a thick armoured gorget, a broad rune-cut belt and armoured greaves; both forearms bare from the elbow so his own amber scales show, crimson thunder blazing out between them and the red veins of light under his skin lit up like molten iron. He carries a huge rune-etched thunder shell cradled in both arms against his chest, red lightning crawling over it, a fierce, roaring look.
formal: At an Amberscale clan rite on the Sky Spine: a long dark amber wool coat closing down the front with horn buttons, fitted sleeves, a broad belt with a bronze dragon-scale buckle, a mantle of dark red cloth over the shoulders, polished boots, the hair tied back. He stands straight with the hands clasped behind his back, a grave, stern look.
art: A low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the gold-brown eyes glaring at the viewer mid-shout, red light blazing between the amber scales of a raised forearm. Searing red thunder-glow from below, the cold snow-light of a mountain pass from the other side. Foreground blur: falling hot rain and snow, sparks, a glowing brass cannon breech.

name: 阿丝特丽·霜桨
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:4303
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 202，2694年；约2720年到天灾）｜贫（冰海撑船人家）｜照常｜5档｜南九段的传奇守将，照顶上那一身；2694年还没有炉甲，写成量身打的霜白附魔甲、冰凌形的叠层肩甲，冰蓝符文；包铁长桨是页上的招牌
who: Astri Frostoar, called the Oar on the Molten River, a human of the far north who poled ice boats on the frozen sea as a child, the legendary warden of the Ninth South section of the wall; her name was fixed at thirty-one and she has looked thirty-one ever since: tall, 182 cm, broad-shouldered. Pale flaxen hair in one thick braid coiled at the back of her head. Grey-blue eyes. A thin white frost-crack scar across the left brow bone (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Fair northern skin. Frost forms wherever she steps. A blunt, quick-tempered air with a long memory; she always asks for a name first.
build: 182 cm, tall and strong: broad shoulders, a D-cup, a firm waist and full hips.
palette: pale flax and frost white, ice blue, garrison grey, blackened rope, molten red-orange
casual: Her wall clothes: a faded long grey garrison coat over a thick northern wool tunic, a broad belt, close wool trousers tucked into heavy boots crusted white with frost at the toes. She leans on a long iron-shod oar a head taller than she is, its shaft wound round and round with blackened rope, a blunt, impatient look as if about to ask your name.
private: In her stone room by the section gate: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, dark wool trousers, thick knitted socks, the braid let down over one shoulder. She holds a small chisel and a wooden tally board covered in carved names, a quiet, stubborn look.
battle: Poling a piece of the wall across the molten river, in the legendary wall-warden's war harness: a fitted coat of frost-white enchanted plates over quilted grey wool, the rune lines glowing ice blue and rimed with frost, broad layered pauldrons like stacked ice floes, steel vambraces and greaves, a short cloak of northern grey fur; frost crystals crust her boots and climb her greaves. She plants the long iron-shod oar a head taller than she is with both hands on the shaft, the shaft wound with blackened rope, the iron blade glowing ice blue and steaming white, a fierce, set look.
formal: At the section gate on a day of remembrance: the long grey garrison coat brushed clean and buttoned to the throat, a northern sealskin mantle trimmed with white fur, a broad belt, polished boots, the braid freshly coiled. She stands straight with the long oar upright at her side, a grave look.
art: A low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the grey-blue eyes demanding the viewer's name, the frost-white oar blade beside her face. Red-orange glow of molten rock from below, cold white frost-mist from the other side. Foreground blur: steam, ice crystals, glowing embers.
